# pulp_distributions (Data Source)

Lists all Pulp Distributions for a given content_type/plugin_name. Useful for discovering Distributions that were created dynamically, e.g. by a `container`/`pull-through` Distribution when an image is pulled through it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pulp_distributions" "docker_pull_through" {
  content_type = "container"
  plugin_name  = "pull-through"
}

# The container/pull-through distribution type automatically creates a new
# Distribution (and backing Remote) each time an image is pulled through it.
# This data source lets you discover those dynamically-created Distributions.
output "docker_pull_through_base_paths" {
  value = [for d in data.pulp_distributions.docker_pull_through.distributions : d.base_path]
}

# Filters are also supported to narrow down the results.
data "pulp_distributions" "docker_specific" {
  content_type = "container"
  plugin_name  = "pull-through"
  base_path    = "docker/library/nginx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_type` (String) Content plugin type.
- `plugin_name` (String) Plugin sub-type if different from content_type.

### Optional

- `base_path` (String) Filter results to the Distribution with this exact `base_path`.
- `name` (String) Filter results to the Distribution with this exact `name`.

### Read-Only

- `distributions` (Attributes List) The list of matching Distributions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--distributions))

<a id="nestedatt--distributions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `distributions`

Read-Only:

- `allow_uploads` (Boolean) Whether to allow uploads to this Distribution.
- `base_path` (String) The base_path for this Distribution.
- `content_guard` (String) The `pulp_href` of the Content Guard used for this Distribution (if supported by the content_type/plugin_name).
- `distributions` (List of String) List of Distributions that use this Distribution as a remote (if supported by the content_type/plugin_name).
- `name` (String) A unique name for this Distribution.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of this Distribution (if supported by the content_type/plugin_name).
- `private` (Boolean) If set to true, this disallows anonymous users to pull from this Distribution.
- `pulp_href` (String) The `pulp_href` (used as the resource identifier).
- `pulp_labels` (Map of String) Key/value labels.
- `remote` (String) The `pulp_href` of the Remote from which content should be pulled.
- `repository` (String) The name of the Repository that should be served at the base_path.
- `repository_version` (String) The version of the Repository.
